description: Source code for SimpleAuthenticationServer class implementing an AMQP-based authentication server with connection handling, session management, and link attachment logic.

classes.name: SimpleAuthenticationServer
classes.description: A final class extending AmqpServiceBase, implementing an AMQP authentication server with connection and link handling.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets specific configuration for the service, annotated with @Autowired.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the service name constant for authentication.

methods.name: setRemoteConnectionOpenHandler
methods.description: Configures handlers for session open, sender open, disconnect, close, and open events on the ProtonConnection.

methods.name: processRemoteOpen
methods.description: Processes the remote open frame, checks for ADDRESS_AUTHZ capability, and sets a timeout to close inactive connections.

methods.name: handleReceiverOpen
methods.description: Handles receiver link open requests by rejecting them with a NOT_ALLOWED condition.

methods.name: handleSenderOpen
methods.description: Handles sender link open requests, validates resource identifiers, checks client authentication, and attaches endpoints or rejects requests.
